title: Feature request: Return only facets that have a count greater than 0
body:
Recently, the support for wildcard facet_by was merged (see https://github.com/typesense/typesense/pull/850). This feature is particularly useful when dealing with a large number of different filters that frequently change dynamically. When we have several hundred facets, using `facet_by: "*"` will return a considerable amount of unnecessary response data if the count on most of them is 0 (which is often the case when we make the search scope smaller by using a query or any other filter).

It would be beneficial to have a feature that allows us to exclude facets from the response if they contain no value. While this can be done on the client-side, having a server-side feature would be a valuable addition.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
@reporter 

Thank you for reporting this. I agree that this will be a great usability addition. I think, by default, we should not return zero counts at all in a dynamic facet scenario.
